name: sharpen
description: Turn vague prompts into specific, engineered ones. Reads your conversation, your codebase and your installed skills, agents and MCP tools, then offers 2-3 sharpened versions to pick from.

interface.longDescription: Sharpen engineers prompts from the conversation, repository and available Codex tools, then presents a native review choice before work begins.
defaultPrompt: Use Sharpen to make my next prompt precise and grounded in this repository.
Sharpen: help me plan this feature before changing files.
